fr.sorbonne_u.components.tasks_management

Class BCM4JavaComponentThread

  • java.lang.Object
    • java.lang.Thread
      • fr.sorbonne_u.components.tasks_management.BCM4JavaComponentThread
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    java.lang.Runnable

    public class BCM4JavaComponentThread
extends java.lang.Thread
    The class BCM4JavaComponentThread defines a specific type of threads for rBCM4Java which names derives from the URI of their owner component and which possess an Thread.UncaughtExceptionHandler printing a message on System.err.

    Description

    Implementation Invariants

     invariant       DEFAULT_NAME_PREFIX != null

    Invariants

     invariant       true        // no more invariant

    Created on : 2026-03-12

    Author:
    Jacques Malenfant

    • Method Detail

      • setServiceInvocationInfo

        public void setServiceInvocationInfo(AbnormalTerminationNotificationOutboundPort notificationDestination,
                                     java.lang.String notificationInboundPortURI,
                                     java.lang.Class<? extends OfferedCI> offeredInterface,
                                     java.lang.String serviceInboundPortURI,
                                     java.lang.String serviceName,
                                     java.io.Serializable[] actualParameters)
        set the reference through which the notification must be made and the information about the faulty call.

        Contract

         pre     notificationDestination != null
 pre     offeredInterface != null
 pre     inboundPortURI != null && !inboundPortURI.isEmpty()
 pre     serviceName != null && !serviceName.isEmpty()
 pre     actualParameters != null
 post    true        // no postcondition.
        Parameters:
        notificationDestination - outbound port through which the notification has to be performed, by default it should be the reference to an outbound port requiring AbnormalTerminationNotificationCI.
        notificationInboundPortURI - URI of the inbound port that must receive the notification.
        offeredInterface - interface offered by the notifier through which the faulty call was made.
        serviceInboundPortURI - URI of the inbound port offering offeredInterface through which the faulty call was made.
        serviceName - name of the faultly called service in offeredInterface.
        actualParameters - parameters passed to the faultly called service.
